utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the timing and what to bring for the repair drive. Once the schedule and list are set, I can plan better.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — I’ll confirm the time, the location, and whether anything else is still needed. Gus has the basics covered, and Rey is checking the cracked step today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — that helps a lot. I’ll wait for the final timing and list so I can bring the right things.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got my toolbox, tools, and a few basic supplies ready for the repair drive. If Eli needs anything else, just let me know and I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — that’s a big help. I’m just checking one or two details, then I’ll confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’m happy to help however I can. Just let me know once Eli’s list is ready and I’ll check if I can bring anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to hear — I’ll keep an ear out for Leo’s confirmation and pass along anything I hear. Hopefully Quinn turns up a few more neighbors today, too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll watch for any updates on the parts and the volunteer count while I’m out. I’ll circle back if I hear anything useful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara — can you also tell me what parts are still missing? I’m trying to pin down exactly what the drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check what’s still missing and let you know as soon as I can. If you want, I can also ask Faye and Gus to compare notes so we can fill the gaps faster.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Sam’s really starting with the fixes, then? Just want to make sure we’ve got the right tools and parts lined up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, we’ve still got a short list to finish, and I’m pretty sure the loose fence board is one of the bits left. Hana’s still checking the timing and supplies, so we should be set once Vik’s list comes through.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so we’re still waiting on Vik’s list and the fence board is one of the last fixes, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still asking around about the repair drive timing and what supplies we should bring. If I hear anything solid, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. I’m keeping track of requests, and Dane, Cleo, Leo, and Rey are all on their pieces, so we should have the Sunday repair drive at the community center covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll keep asking around and let you know if I hear the exact time or any supply updates.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that really helps. I’m still waiting on the final time and supply list, so I’ll hold off until that’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the repair-drive supplies and set aside anything we can spare, especially anything useful for the fence board or porch step.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — 4:30 after pickup works for me. I’ll keep gathering the last details and let Maple Street know we still need a few spare parts and more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m going to check what needs fixing first, then I’ll grab anything useful from the back shed and porch boxes for the hall.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds about right — the repair drive is still on, and Gus can bring his toolkit and a few basics once Leo confirms the time. I think Rey’s still keeping track of Eli’s list too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll start checking the fixes now and keep an eye out for anything useful to bring over. If you hear who’s free today, let me know and I’ll ask around too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I can help confirm the time, location, and any tools or parts we still need for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — Sunday at the community center is the spot, and Leo’s still checking the time before he confirms it. If you can help with tools or parts, just loop in Rosa’s list once it comes through.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll watch for Rosa’s list and help pin down any tools or parts we still need.

utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the final time, location, and whether we need any extra tools or parts. Rey, once you’ve checked the cracked step today, let’s lock those details in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll check the cracked step today and then we can lock it in once Leo confirms the time. Oren still flagged the loose fence board too, so I’ll keep that on the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll check the school schedule and send you the time and place as soon as I have it. We still need tools, spare parts, and a few extra hands, so I really appreciate you helping out.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — I’m spreading the word right away and inviting a few more neighbors today. I’ll let Uli know who can help, and Mara’s checking her schedule too.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s coming together nicely, even if we’re still waiting on the time and place. I’ve heard we may still need a few more tools, parts, and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I’m hoping Quinn can ask a few more neighbors today. Once we know the timing and supplies, we’ll be in better shape.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, and Bo said he’d pass the details along to the other parents and bring some supplies too. With Gus’s toolbox and a good turnout, it’s sounding pretty solid.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word and pass along the remaining list — it’s the loose fence board on Oren’s side and the cracked porch step with Rey.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — once you confirm the time, I’ll keep sharing it with everyone and repeat the plan.
